name: usezn
description: Plugins from usezn: zn-gate, a local security layer for coding agents.

plugins.name: zn-gate
plugins.description: Blocks reads and writes of secret files, shell commands and MCP calls that would handle a secret, and prompts that contain one. Keeps protecting when ZCode's own hooks switch is off. Runs a pinned, verified copy of zn-gate shipped inside the plugin; no account, no API key.
